t: This is the Sam Wanamaker Playhouse, an indoor theatre that is part of Shakespeare's Globe on Bankside. It was built using seventeenth-century plans for an indoor English theatre, and it recalls the layout and style of the Blackfriars Theatre, though it isn't an exact reconstruction. It is named after Sam Wanamaker, the American actor and director. He began on Broadway but spent much of his working life in Britain, where he moved after fearing he would be blacklisted in Hollywood in the 1950s.
